method: One fresh production CLI exploration, unchanged Japanese Goal, image-only with isolated requirement reading and selected completion evidence. No supplied answers or routes. Sequential, same-origin, read-only, 2000ms interval, max-actions=0. No production changes in this validation.

limits: One run, not a general accuracy or completion-rate estimate.
